description: High-performance data pipelines with Polars, DuckDB in-process analytics, Pandas EDA transformations, and Python code quality commands.
ai_rules: Prefer Polars LazyFrame (scan_csv, scan_parquet) over eager loading for large datasets to optimize memory and execution plans.
Validate input datasets against schema definitions and handle NaN/Null values explicitly before model training or aggregation.
Use DuckDB for ad-hoc analytical SQL queries directly against Parquet or CSV files without spinning up an external database.

snippets.label: Polars LazyFrame Aggregation Pipeline
snippets.body:
import polars as pl

def process_analytics(filepath: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    q = (
        pl.scan_parquet(filepath)
        .filter(pl.col("status") == "completed")
        .group_by("category")
        .agg([
            pl.col("amount").sum().alias("total_revenue"),
            pl.col("user_id").n_unique().alias("unique_customers"),
            pl.col("amount").mean().alias("avg_order_value"),
        ])
        .sort("total_revenue", descending=True)
    )
    return q.collect()

snippets.label: DuckDB SQL Query Over Parquet Files
snippets.body:
import duckdb

def query_dataset(parquet_path: str):
    con = duckdb.connect(database=":memory:")
    query = f"""
        SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(price) as avg_price
        FROM '{parquet_path}'
        GROUP BY category
        ORDER BY count DESC
        LIMIT 20
    """
    return con.execute(query).df()

snippets.label: Pandas Missing Value Imputation and Summary
snippets.body:
import pandas as pd

def clean_dataframe(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cleaned = df.copy()
    numeric_cols = cleaned.select_dtypes(include=['number']).columns
    cleaned[numeric_cols] = cleaned[numeric_cols].fillna(cleaned[numeric_cols].median())
    categorical_cols = cleaned.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns
    cleaned[categorical_cols] = cleaned[categorical_cols].fillna('UNKNOWN')
    return cleaned
